node.statement: Differentiated identity: for xi in icalH put P=DF_s(A)xi=DB(A)xi and R=DQ(A)xi. Differentiating the exact full coordinate factorization gives -xi+DG(A)xi=P+DG(B)P+R+E, where E=(P+DG(B)P) bold-dot Q+(B+G(B)) bold-dot R. The first two terms P,xi are anti-Hermitian whereas DG(A)xi,DG(B)P,R are Hermitian. Therefore P+xi=-P^par(E) and R=DG(A)xi-DG(B)P-P^perp(E). The scalar graph estimate applies at ||A||<=r and ||B||<=2r, giving ||DG(A)||,||DG(B)||<=K_g*r.
